verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a dedicated Sandbox environment for development and testing. It supports all API and Link functionality and unlimited test Items, and a Sandbox-only endpoint creates Items with test credentials, so it is true environment isolation rather than a dry-run mode. missing for 10: an explicit documented statement that Sandbox data is fully isolated from Production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Plaid Sandbox is a free and fully-featured environment for application development and testing. All Plaid functionality of both the Plaid API and Plaid Link is supported in the Sandbox environment.
you can create an unlimited number of test Items

you can also create Items in Sandbox via the API, using a special Sandbox-only endpoint, /sandbox/public_token/create. This endpoint allows you to generate a public_token for an arbitrary institution ID, initial products, and test credentials.
